from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyMetricRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial metric record extracted from one company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company (e.g., 江苏洋河酒厂股份有限公司)")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/Security code if available")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The name of the metric line item (e.g., 非流动资产合计)")
    metric_value: float = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric as reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., 元)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 2024 年第一季度)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim text from the document confirming the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    metrics: list[CompanyMetricRecord]
